record.field: SELECT DISTINCT a.aufnr, a.auart, d.matnr, md.maktx, pt.priokx, a.ktext, fe.fetxt, d.bdmng, f.bwart, t156.btext AS bwart_text, s2.srvpos, s2.ktext1, a.werks FROM aufk a left JOIN afko k ON a.mandt = k.mandt AND a.aufnr = k.aufnr left JOIN afih b ON a.mandt = b.mandt AND a.aufnr = b.aufnr left JOIN resb d ON a.mandt = d.mandt AND k.rsnum = d.rsnum left JOIN makt e ON d.mandt = e.mandt AND e.matnr = d.matnr left JOIN mseg f ON a.mandt = f.mandt AND a.aufnr = f.aufnr AND f.matnr = d.matnr left JOIN qmel qm ON a.mandt = qm.mandt AND a.aufnr = qm.aufnr INNER JOIN viqmfe fe ON qm.mandt = fe.mandt AND qm.qmnum = fe.qmnum inner JOIN t356_t pt ON pt.mandt = b.mandt AND pt.priok = b.priok AND pt.spras = 'E' AND pt.artpr = 'PM' LEFT JOIN afvc v ON k.mandt = v.mandt AND k.aufpl = v.aufpl LEFT JOIN esll s1 ON v.mandt = s1.mandt AND v.packno = s1.packno LEFT JOIN esll s2 ON s1.mandt = s2.mandt AND s1.sub_packno = s2.packno LEFT JOIN t156t t156 ON f.mandt = t156.mandt AND f.bwart = t156.bwart AND f.sobkz = t156.sobkz AND t156.spras = 'E' inner join makt md on d.matnr = md.matnr and d.mandt = md.mandt and md.spras = 'E' WHERE (f.bwart IS NULL OR f.bwart IN ('Z61','Z62','101')) and (f.bwart IS NULL OR f.bwart = 'Z61' OR f.bwart = '101') and a.werks in('1321','1443')

SELECT DISTINCT a.aufnr, a.auart, b.equnr, il.tplnr, d.matnr, md.maktx, pt.priokx, a.ktext, fe.fetxt, d.bdmng, afk.gstrp, a.werks, f.bwart, t156.btext AS bwart_text, s2.srvpos, s2.ktext1 FROM aufk a INNER JOIN afih b ON a.mandt = b.mandt AND a.aufnr = b.aufnr INNER JOIN afko afk ON afk.mandt = a.mandt AND afk.aufnr = a.aufnr left JOIN resb d ON d.mandt = a.mandt AND d.rsnum = afk.rsnum left JOIN makt e ON e.mandt = d.mandt AND e.matnr = d.matnr AND e.spras = 'E' left JOIN mseg f ON f.mandt = a.mandt AND f.aufnr = a.aufnr AND f.matnr = d.matnr INNER JOIN qmel qm ON qm.mandt = a.mandt AND qm.aufnr = a.aufnr LEFT JOIN viqmfe fe ON fe.mandt = qm.mandt AND fe.qmnum = qm.qmnum LEFT JOIN t356_t pt ON pt.mandt = b.mandt AND pt.priok = b.priok AND pt.spras = 'E' AND pt.artpr = 'PM' LEFT JOIN iloa il ON il.mandt = b.mandt AND il.iloan = b.iloan LEFT JOIN afvc v ON v.mandt = afk.mandt AND v.aufpl = afk.aufpl LEFT JOIN esll s1 ON s1.mandt = v.mandt AND s1.packno = v.packno LEFT JOIN esll s2 ON s2.mandt = s1.mandt AND s2.packno = s1.sub_packno LEFT JOIN t156t t156 ON t156.mandt = f.mandt AND t156.bwart = f.bwart AND t156.sobkz = f.sobkz AND t156.spras = 'E' inner join makt md on d.matnr = md.matnr and d.mandt = md.mandt and md.spras = 'E' WHERE a.auart IN ('ZLF2','ZLF3','ZLF4','ZLF5','ZLF6','ZLS2','ZLS3','ZLS4','ZLS5','ZLS6') AND (f.bwart IS NULL OR f.bwart IN ('Z61','Z62','101')) AND (f.bwart IS NULL OR f.bwart = 'Z61' OR f.bwart = '101') and a.werks in('1321','1443')

SELECT DISTINCT a.aufnr, a.auart, b.equnr, il.tplnr, d.matnr, pt.priokx, a.ktext, fe.fetxt, d.bdmng, afk.gstrp, a.werks, f.bwart, t156.btext AS bwart_text, s2.srvpos, s2.ktext1 FROM aufk a INNER JOIN afih b ON a.mandt = b.mandt AND a.aufnr = b.aufnr INNER JOIN afko afk ON afk.mandt = a.mandt AND afk.aufnr = a.aufnr LEFT JOIN resb d ON d.mandt = a.mandt AND d.rsnum = afk.rsnum LEFT JOIN makt e ON e.mandt = d.mandt AND e.matnr = d.matnr AND e.spras = 'E' LEFT JOIN mseg f ON f.mandt = a.mandt AND f.aufnr = a.aufnr AND f.matnr = d.matnr LEFT JOIN qmel qm ON qm.mandt = a.mandt AND qm.aufnr = a.aufnr LEFT JOIN viqmfe fe ON fe.mandt = qm.mandt AND fe.qmnum = qm.qmnum LEFT JOIN t356_t pt ON pt.mandt = b.mandt AND pt.priok = b.priok AND pt.spras = 'E' AND pt.artpr = 'PM' LEFT JOIN iloa il ON il.mandt = b.mandt AND il.iloan = b.iloan LEFT JOIN afvc v ON v.mandt = afk.mandt AND v.aufpl = afk.aufpl LEFT JOIN esll s1 ON s1.mandt = v.mandt AND s1.packno = v.packno LEFT JOIN esll s2 ON s2.mandt = s1.mandt AND s2.packno = s1.sub_packno LEFT JOIN t156t t156 ON t156.mandt = f.mandt AND t156.bwart = f.bwart AND t156.sobkz = f.sobkz AND t156.spras = 'E' WHERE a.auart IN ('ZLF4','ZLS4') AND a.werks IN ('1321','1443') AND (f.bwart IS NULL OR f.bwart NOT IN ('Z61','Z62','101'))
select a.grund, a.grdtx, a.werks from trugt a where a.werks in('1321','1443') and a.spras = 'EN'
